GENERAL HEADQUARTERS
SUPREME COMMANDER FOR THE ALLIED POWERS
AG 676.3 (24 Jan 46) CCS
(SCAPIN - 651)
24 January 1946
MEMORANDUM FOR : IMPERIAL JAPANESE GOVERNMENT.
THROUGH : Central Liaison Office, Tokyo.
SUBJECT : Proposed Radio Circuit between Tokyo and Maizuru.
Reference letter S 717, dated 19 January 1946, subject; "Opening of Wireless Communication System Maizuru－Tokyo", from Liaison Commission (Tokyo) for the Imperial Japanese Demobilization Ministries, opening of the proposed radio circuit between Maizutu and Tokyo, call sign "Tsu-To-Ma", is not authorized.
FOR THE SUPREME COMMANDER:
H.W.ALLEN,
Colonel, A.G.D.,
Asst Adjutant General.
